case.question: I fish from the pier for salmon. For this week, how good do you expect pier fishing for salmon to be at each of St. Joseph, South Haven, Grand Haven and Muskegon? Rate each port 0-4 (0 slow, 1 below average, 2 average, 3 good, 4 excellent) and say which you'd go to.

events.text:
## Recommendation

- **Pier rating for this week: St. Joseph 1, South Haven 1 (inferred), Grand Haven 1, Muskegon 0.** Nothing rates above below-average, so I'd treat the pier as a weak option this week.
- **Go to St. Joseph's pier heads first.** It's the only pier-area spot with a recent catch, though it was a boat catch.
- **If the pier is slow, go by boat.** Grand Haven and South Haven had the best recent boat reports.
- **Boat tip:** run spoons (green, yellow, orange) about 55-110 ft down over 120-210 ft of water off Grand Haven, or about 110 ft off South Haven.

## Why

- **Pier reports have been slow at every port.** The Sept 14 and Sept 7 Grand Haven reports both rated the pier 0 (slow), and the Sept 7 Muskegon report said no salmon were reported from the breakwalls (Grand Haven, 2022-09-14; Grand Haven, 2022-09-07; Muskegon, 2022-09-07).
- **St. Joseph has the only recent pier-area catch.** Boats fishing the pier heads caught a couple of coho and Chinook, rated 1 (St. Joseph, 2022-09-14).
- **South Haven has no pier report.** I'd expect its pier to be about as slow as its neighbors, since its boat fishing was average to good (South Haven, 2022-09-14).
- **Today's water is warm and flat.** Buoy surface water is about 70-72 F and hasn't moved much over the week, so I'd expect salmon to stay deeper and away from the piers (Conditions now). This is my inference, based on the general guidance below.

## Evidence

**Recent reports** (last four weeks, salmon)
- Grand Haven, 2022-09-14: boats rated 3 (good) with spoons and flies at 55-110 ft down in 120-210 ft of water; pier "slow for salmon," rated 0.
- Muskegon, 2022-09-14: boats rated 1 at 55-100 ft down in 100-200 ft of water; "a few salmon" near the sand docks in Muskegon Lake. No pier-specific salmon report.
- South Haven, 2022-09-14: boats rated 2 ("decent fishing when they could get out"), best water about 110 ft, mostly on spoons. No pier report.
- St. Joseph, 2022-09-14: "a couple of boats fishing the pier heads and caught a couple of coho and Chinook," rated 1.
- Earlier: Grand Haven boats rated 2 on 2022-09-07, and South Haven boats rated 3 on the same date (best water about 40 ft). The pier was slow at Grand Haven and Muskegon that week.
- In late August, the St. Joseph pier had "a few fish around the piers" with slow fishing (2022-08-24), and the Grand Haven pier had a few coho with slow action (2022-08-24).

**Past seasons**
- The similar-water search (buoy about 71 F, ±4 F, within 21 days) returned only this year's reports. I found no earlier seasons to compare, so I have no historical pier pattern for these conditions.

**Conditions now**
- Buoy surface water: St. Joseph 70 F (−1 F over the week), South Haven 71 F (flat), Grand Haven 71 F (flat), Muskegon 71 F (flat) (the buoy data is from the week before 2022-09-20).
- Reference (NY DEC): Chinook and coho prefer 52-58 F, so at these temperatures they'd be holding deeper, away from the surface.
- Reference (Michigan Sea Grant / MSU Extension): north or east winds cause upwelling, which can bring salmon to pierheads. I had no wind forecast or modeled pierhead water to check for that, so I can't say whether it's happening.

## Caveats

- **The newest report is 6 days old** (2022-09-14). The fall season changes fast, so this is a guide, not a current read.
- **Live pier data was not available.** Current conditions gave buoy surface temperatures only, with no modeled pierhead temperature, no temperature trend, and no wind forecast. I couldn't check for an upwelling, which is the main thing that could make the pier better this week.
- **The pier ratings are thin.** The reports had no pier data for South Haven, and the St. Joseph catch was from boats. The South Haven 1 rating is my inference from its neighbors.

## Sources

- Grand Haven, Muskegon, South Haven, St. Joseph, 2022-09-14: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/32cff90
- Grand Haven, Muskegon, South Haven, St. Joseph, 2022-09-07: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/32bbcf0
- Grand Haven, Muskegon, South Haven, St. Joseph, 2022-08-24: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3298204
